references.text: A contrasting parallel describing the curses that come from disobedience, in contrast to the blessings that come from obedience to the Lord's voice.
The same promise of blessings resulting from obedience to the Lord's commands and covenant obligations.
A parallel text promising blessings when Israel listens to the Lord's commands and serves him.
The fundamental principle that obedience to the Lord's voice leads to blessing and protection.
A covenant promise where obedience to the Lord's voice results in Israel becoming God's treasured possession.
Parallel blessings promised to those who walk in the Lord's statutes and keep his commands.
The blessings and curses that come upon the people based on their obedience to the Lord's voice.
A promise of safety and peace from disaster for the one who listens to wisdom's voice.
A prophetic confirmation that obedience to the Lord leads to enjoying the land's good things.
